evidence: Modifies `CBlockIndexWorkComparator` in `src/node/blockstorage.h` and arithmetic comparisons used for chainstate block index management.
rationale: Optimizes hot-path block index work comparison logic used during chainstate evaluation and candidates sorting. Benchmarks show `CBlockIndexWorkComparator` throughput increases 6.5x–6.8x and `CheckBlockIndex` ops/s improve 1.4x–1.6x, providing a worthwhile micro-optimization to block index operations.
